gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold CC mentions only anxiety symptoms. Generated CC adds poor sleep and palpitations, but there is no generated fact that exclusively states 'patient presents with anxiety symptoms' as chief complaint.

Gold: two‑month history of feeling anxious all the time. Generated hpi-001: symptoms began about two months ago, coinciding with new job; hpi-003: daily anxiety. Together they cover chronic, near‑constant anxiety over ~2 months.

Gold: anxiety began after starting a new job in a different industry with pressure from boss. Generated hpi-001: onset with new, stressful retail head-office job; hpi-002: dreads work and interactions with her boss. Same onset context and work/boss stressor.

Gold: dreads going to work every morning. Generated hpi-002: dreads work and interactions with her boss; hpi-003: daily anxiety especially in the mornings. This captures dread around work in the mornings.
Gold: severe initial insomnia, ~3 hours to fall asleep. Generated hpi-004: sleep-onset insomnia and only ~3–4 hours total sleep; onset difficulty is clearly implied as initial insomnia.
Gold: early-morning waking. Generated hpi-004: wakes before alarm, consistent with early-morning waking.
Gold: often only 3–4 hours sleep. Generated hpi-004: achieves about 3–4 hours of sleep. Directly matches.
Gold: tired during the day. Generated hpi-007: describes daytime low energy and feeling on edge, which includes daytime tiredness/low energy.
Gold: low energy. Generated hpi-007: explicitly notes low energy during the day.
Gold: eating pattern normal but more chocolate. Generated hpi-011: eating regularly, increased chocolate, no significant change in overall appetite. Equivalent content.
Gold: anhedonia at work and outside; avoids running, tennis, socialising. Generated hpi-007: anhedonia, decreased socializing, reduced running and tennis. Same phenomenon and examples.
Gold: palpitations began with anxiety symptoms. Generated hpi-005: palpitations new in last two months, aligning with onset of anxiety symptoms over same period.

Gold: palpitations feel irregular and with chest discomfort. Generated hpi-005: perceived irregular; hpi-006: discomfort associated with fast heart rate. Together they cover irregular palpitations with chest discomfort.
Gold: palpitations are rapid and last ~2–10 minutes. Generated hpi-005: palpitations last minutes to about 10 minutes; hpi-006: fast heart rate. Matches duration and rapidity.
Gold: patient has not missed work. No generated fact addresses work attendance or missed work.
Gold: public transport is another trigger provoking anxiety. Generated hpi-008: public transport, particularly the tube, is stressful. This captures the same trigger.
Gold: low mood most of the time. Generated hpi-010: reports low mood. Frequency is not restated, but presence of low mood is captured.

Gold: no past psychiatric history or significant anxiety. Generated hpi-009 (no prior similar episodes) and hpi-012 (no prior therapy) do not explicitly state no past psychiatric history or no significant prior anxiety; they are not equivalent.
Gold: mother has history of depression. Generated fh-001 states exactly the same.
Gold: lives with supportive parents. Generated sh-001: lives with her parents. Supportiveness is not repeated but living situation is covered.

Gold: drinks Fri/Sat, amount uncertain but sometimes overdoes it. Generated sh-002: drinks more heavily Fri/Sat, sometimes more than recommended, plus occasional weekday wine. This includes and expands on the weekend pattern and occasional excess.
Gold: smokes occasionally. Generated sh-003: occasional smoker. Direct match.
Gold: no illicit drugs. Generated sh-004: denies use of other drugs. Reasonably equivalent in context of social history substance use.
Gold: work-related anxiety. Generated asm-001: assesses work-related anxiety with insomnia and functional impact, no SI. Contains and adds to the gold impression.
Gold: insomnia. Generated asm-001: includes insomnia as part of the assessment. Same diagnosis.
Gold: advised self-referral to NHS talking therapies. Generated plan-001: self-refer to NHS talking therapies (CBT). Same instruction with added CBT detail.
Gold: advised to access online CBT resources. Generated plan-002: advised to start recommended online resources immediately. This reflects the same plan (online resources), with timing detail added.

Gold: blood tests as initial investigation for palpitations, booked via support team. Generated plan-006: arrange basic blood tests; patient to call to book. Same overall plan of blood tests to be arranged by patient calling to book, though mechanism/team detail differs.

Gold: contact clinic if anxiety/mood worse or unable to cope with work. Generated plan-004: safety-net to call back if symptoms worsen or unable to cope with work/ADLs. This encompasses the gold follow-up/safety-net advice with additional ADLs detail.
Gold: no panic attacks. Generated content mentions 'panic' sensation on waking but does not state denial of panic attacks explicitly; absence of explicit 'no panic attacks' makes this not covered.
Gold: denies suicidal ideation. Generated hpi-010 and asm-001 both state no/denies SI, matching this.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Gold CC only lists 'anxiety symptoms'. Generated CC adds poor sleep and palpitations and duration (~2 months), which are not specified as chief complaint items in the gold note.

Supported in part by gold hpi-001 and hpi-002 regarding 2-month onset and new job, but the specific detail 'retail head-office' and explicit labeling as 'stressful' are not in the gold facts. Overall this extends the gold information.
Gold notes that the patient dreads work every morning and that pressures from boss are present. 'Dreads work and interactions with her boss' is consistent with and supported by this.

Gold indicates feeling anxious all the time (hpi-001) and dreading work most mornings (hpi-003), but does not specify 'especially in the mornings' or 'difficulty getting out of bed'. These are new, though directionally consistent, details.

Gold supports sleep-onset insomnia, early-morning waking, and 3–4 hours total sleep (hpi-004–hpi-006), but does not mention waking before alarm 'with a racing heart and panic'. The physiologic association on waking is new detail.

Gold hpi-011–hpi-013 describe palpitations that began with anxiety, feel irregular, are rapid, and last ~2–10 minutes. Generated hpi-005 matches irregularity, duration, and new onset in last two months, consistent with the gold description.

Gold states 'chest discomfort' with rapid palpitations but does not say 'no true chest pain'. The clarification that there is no true chest pain adds nuance not present in the gold facts, without contradicting them.

Gold hpi-007–hpi-010 describe tiredness, low energy, anhedonia, and reduced running, tennis, and socialising. Generated hpi-007 restates these and adds 'feels on edge', which is consistent with anxiety; overall supported.

Gold indicates public transport as anxiety provoking and work-related anxiety as the main issue. Generated hpi-008 states public transport (tube) is stressful and anxiety mainly work-focused, which aligns with these gold facts.

Gold pmh-001 says no past psychiatric history or significant anxiety, but does not explicitly say 'no prior similar episodes of these symptoms.' This is a related but more specific statement and is therefore an addition.

Contains three components: low mood (supported by hpi-016), denies SI (supported by ros-002), and good family support (gold sh-001 only notes 'supportive parents' but not explicitly as current support in mood/safety context). The bundling and framing as 'good family support' in mood/safety context adds to gold.
Gold hpi-009: eating pattern normal but more chocolate. Generated hpi-011: eating regularly, increased chocolate, no significant appetite change. This is fully consistent.
Gold pmh-001 states no past psychiatric history, but does not directly address prior therapy or openness to therapy. 'No prior therapy; open to 1:1 therapy' is new information.
Exactly matches the gold family history of maternal depression.
Gold: lives with supportive parents. Generated: lives with her parents. The living arrangement is supported; omission of 'supportive' is not contradictory.

Gold: drinks Fri/Sat, sometimes overdoes it. Generated adds that weekend drinking is sometimes above recommendations and that she also drinks occasional weekday wine. The weekday wine and explicit tie to guideline exceedance are additions.
Directly aligns with 'Smokes occ.'
Gold: no illicit drugs. Generated: no other drugs. In context, this is consistent and supported.
Gold facts do not specify the exact occupation or workplace type. 'Fashion retailer head office' is entirely new contextual information.

Gold assessment lists work-related anxiety and insomnia. Generated asm-001 specifies work-related anxiety with insomnia and functional impact, and notes no SI. This is consistent and extends the gold assessment.

Gold does not have an assessment statement about palpitations being likely anxiety-related or characterizing episodes as brief morning episodes with no true chest pain. These are new interpretive details.
Gold: self-referral to NHS talking therapies. Generated: same plus specifying CBT and that a link will be sent. Supported with added detail.
Gold plan-002: advised to access online CBT resources in the meantime. Generated: advised to start recommended online resources immediately. This is consistent and reinforces timing.
Gold plan does not mention sleep hygiene advice. Including 'sleep hygiene advice' is a new element of the plan.

Gold fu-001: contact us if anxiety/mood symptoms worse or unable to cope with work. Generated plan-004: call back if worsening or unable to cope with work/ADLs. This is consistent with the gold safety-net advice, with added ADL detail.
Gold plan does not mention medication consideration. The possibility of meds if inadequate response is new and not evidenced in the gold facts.

Gold: blood tests as initial investigation for palpitations; patient advised to book via support team. Generated: arrange basic blood tests; patient to call to book. Same high-level plan; the specific booking mechanism is slightly different but not contradictory.

Gold follow-up information is limited to safety-net contact if symptoms worsen or work becomes unmanageable. A scheduled GP follow-up 1 week after bloods is not mentioned in the gold facts and is therefore new.
Gold facts include no physical examination or mental status description. 'Appears quite distressed' is new observational information.
